title: 优待
slug: 姜姬全本免费-姜姬最新章节列表
content_zh:
他们俩的棍子和姜元的一样，这就是成人用的。姜元让他们一开始就使这个，所以这两人一开始能做的就是拖着棍子漫山跑，姜元在后面举着棍子追打，如果姜武和姜奔在跑的时候把棍子扔了，就不许吃饭，还要挨十杖打屁股，挨打时还必须站着，被打趴下就要赶紧爬起来，再站好挨打。
吃了两个月饱饭后，姜武和姜奔的个头都往上蹿了一截，也长了力气，终于能把棍子抡起来了，但距离能跟姜元对打还早得很。
如果说这个家中现在谁最辛苦就是这两兄弟了。他们就算在下雪之后也只能穿单衣，买回来的皮袄只有四个人有：姜元、陶氏、姜姬与姜旦。
姜武、姜奔、姜粟、姜谷四人都没有。但是没人抱怨，在姜元来之前他们本来也不会有皮袄可以过冬，何况又买了那么多粮食，现在每人每天都能吃很多饭，还有什么好不满足的呢？钱是姜元的，陶氏是“娘”，姜姬与姜旦是家里最小的，只有他们有皮袄穿似乎很合理。
但姜姬还是发现了很多不同，姜元似乎在有意的将大家分隔开来。他成了制定规则的人。
比如姜武和姜奔，他们连屋子都没有，只能睡在姜元和陶氏屋前的廊下。姜姬有不满，可又说不出口，难道她能问姜元为什么不多买些木头，盖几个足够所有人睡下的大屋吗？姜元愿意拿出多少钱就拿多少，而他拿的钱，他要怎么花，也没人能指手划脚。至于为什么木头不够却还要盖一条回廊，还要在屋里做区隔，可能……可能这里的屋子就是这么盖的，可能姜元不想住得太差——他似乎并不是一般人。
总之，有不满、有不安的只有姜姬，陶氏他们全部都被姜元“降服”了。陶氏、姜粟、姜谷、姜奔，他们全身心的崇拜他，信服他。
“就到这里。”姜元说，姜武和姜奔听到这句也不敢把棍子扔掉，而是先单膝跪下，“喏！”然后再拖着棍子蹒跚的离开，今天他们的身上又添了许多青紫。
离开前，姜武对在廊下坐下看他们练武的姜姬做了个鬼脸。
姜元赤着上身过来，对姜姬露出笑容，温声道：“怎么坐在此处？小心被风雪吹到了。”他走到廊上来，说：“下回去买粮食买些帘子回来，挂在这里。”
他向里面走，陶氏早就听到他的声音，急步从火塘边过来说：“已经烧好了热水。”
看着姜元的背影，姜姬发现自己还忽略了一件事：就是姜元的年龄。
从脸上看，他真的十分苍老，有皱纹，满面风尘，还有一头花白的头发。但脱了上衣后，他的肌肉却依然紧实有力！如果只看脸，姜姬会猜他有五十岁以上，但看身体，他不会超过四十岁。
如果再加上他晚上和陶氏在一起的表现，还可以再减五年。
姜元和陶氏那边渐渐传来不雅的声音，他丝毫不避人，不管早晚，只要他想就会把陶氏推倒。姜姬只好抱着姜旦躲回她的小屋去。
虽然在小屋里还是能听到声音。
她的小屋有一个小窗，只有她的脸那么大。这时窗上传来轻轻的敲击声，她把窗打来，姜武的脸露出来，她就把藏起来的一块粘米团递给他，他一口就给吃了。
姜元买回来的粮食虽然多，但并不是都很好吃，最好吃的是一种细长的紫色的米，最难吃的是一种带黑点的灰白色的谷物，久煮不烂，吃在嘴里像吃石灰粉。
陶氏、姜谷和姜粟做饭时，要把这种灰白色的谷物挑出来，姜元不吃这个，他让姜姬、陶氏跟他一起吃，而这种灰白色的谷物就成了姜武、姜奔、姜谷和姜粟最主要的食物。
姜姬就每天留一个，带给姜武。不止因为姜武跟她最好，还因为姜奔是这个家里最崇拜姜元的人，陶氏虽然也把姜元当成天一样，但她眼里至少还有姜旦，有他们这些“孩子”，而姜奔眼里只有姜元了，他真情实感的认为他们都该相信姜元，怀疑姜元简直是大逆不道。

姜姬在观察过家里所有人之后，只能尽力把姜武拉到她这边。
姜武几口吃掉紫色的粘米团，心满意足的舔舔手指，看看天空说：“现在没雪了，也没风，你想出去走走吗？”

content_en:
Their sticks are the same as Jiang Yuan's, which is for adults. Jiang Yuan asked them to do this from the beginning, so what the two men could do at the beginning was to drag the sticks and run all over the mountain, with Jiang Yuan holding the sticks behind and chasing them. If Jiang Wu and Jiang Ben threw the sticks away while running, they were not allowed to eat, and they were spanked with ten sticks. They had to stand when they were spanked. If they fell down, they had to get up quickly and stand up again to be spanked.
After two months of full meals, Jiang Wu and Jiang Ben both grew taller and stronger. They were finally able to swing sticks, but they were still far away from being able to fight with Jiang Yuan.
If we say who is having the hardest time in this family right now, it is these two brothers. Even after it snowed, they could only wear single clothes. Only four of them bought fur jackets: Jiang Yuan, Tao Shi, Jiang Ji and Jiang Dan.
None of Jiang Wu, Jiang Ben, Jiang Su, and Jiang Gu. But no one complained. Before Jiang Yuan came, they didn't have fur coats to survive the winter. What's more, they bought so much food. Now everyone can eat a lot of food every day. What else is there to be dissatisfied about? The money belongs to Jiang Yuan, Tao is the "mother", and Jiang Ji and Jiang Dan are the youngest in the family. It seems reasonable that they are the only ones wearing fur coats.
But Jiang Ji still found many differences. Jiang Yuan seemed to be deliberately separating everyone. He became the one who made the rules.
For example, Jiang Wu and Jiang Ben didn't even have a house, so they could only sleep on the porch in front of Jiang Yuan and Tao's house. Jiang Ji was dissatisfied, but she couldn't express it. Could she ask Jiang Yuan why he didn't buy more wood and build a few big houses big enough for everyone to sleep? Jiang Yuan could take as much money as he wanted, and no one could tell him how to spend the money he took. As for why there is not enough wood to build a corridor and make partitions in the house, maybe... maybe the house here is built like this, maybe Jiang Yuan doesn't want to live in such a bad way - he doesn't seem to be an ordinary person.
In short, only Jiang Ji was dissatisfied and uneasy, while Tao and the others were all "surrendered" by Jiang Yuan. Tao, Jiang Su, Jiang Gu, and Jiang Ben worshiped him wholeheartedly and believed in him.
"That's it." Jiang Yuan said. Jiang Wu and Jiang Ben didn't dare to throw away the stick after hearing this. Instead, they knelt down on one knee and said, "Here!" and then staggered away dragging the stick. Today, they had a lot of bruises on their bodies.
Before leaving, Jiang Wu made a face at Jiang Ji, who was sitting in the corridor watching them practice martial arts.
Jiang Yuan came over with his upper body naked, smiled at Jiang Ji, and said warmly: "Why are you sitting here? Be careful of being blown by the wind and snow." He walked to the corridor and said: "I will go back next time to buy food and some curtains, and hang them here."
As he walked inside, Mrs. Tao had already heard his voice and hurriedly came over from the fire pit and said, "The hot water has been boiled."
Looking at Jiang Yuan's back, Jiang Ji found that she had overlooked one thing: Jiang Yuan's age.
Judging from his face, he was really old, wrinkled, dusty, and had gray hair. But after taking off his shirt, his muscles were still tight and strong! If she only looked at his face, Jiang Ji would guess that he was over fifty years old, but looking at his body, he would not be over forty.
If you add in his performance at night with Dow, that's another five years off that.
Indecent voices gradually came from Jiang Yuan and Tao's side. He did not avoid people at all. No matter sooner or later, he would push Tao down if he wanted to. Jiang Ji had no choice but to hug Jiang Dan and hide back in her hut.
Sounds can still be heard in the cabin though.
Her hut had a small window, only as big as her face. At this time, there was a gentle knocking on the window. She opened the window and exposed Jiang Wu's face. She handed him a piece of sticky rice ball that she had hidden, and he ate it in one bite.
Although Jiang Yuan bought a lot of grain, not all of it was delicious. The most delicious was a kind of slender purple rice, and the most unpalatable was a kind of gray-white grain with black spots.Like eating lime powder.
When Tao, Jiang Gu and Jiang Su were cooking, they had to pick out this off-white grain. Jiang Yuan didn't eat it, so he asked Jiang Ji and Tao to eat it with him. This off-white grain became the main food of Jiang Wu, Jiang Ben, Jiang Gu and Jiang Su.
Jiang Ji kept one every day and brought it to Jiang Wu. Not only because Jiang Wu is the best with her, but also because Jiang Ben is the person who admires Jiang Yuan the most in the family. Although Tao also regards Jiang Yuan as a god, at least she still has Jiang Dan and "children" like them in her eyes, while Jiang Ben only sees Jiang Yuan. He truly believes that they should all believe in Jiang Yuan, and it is simply treasonous to doubt Jiang Yuan.
After Jiang Ji observed everyone in the family, she could only try her best to bring Jiang Wu to her side.
Jiang Wu ate the purple sticky rice balls in several bites, licked his fingers with satisfaction, looked at the sky and said, "There is no snow now, and there is no wind. Do you want to go out for a walk?"
